title: Checkout.com pricing - Not publicly listed; interchange++ negotiated per merchant
clean_text: Checkout.com does not display flat-rate pricing publicly the way Stripe or PayPal do; pricing is agreed during onboarding based on the merchant's business profile. Offerings include fully flat-rate plans, free processing for registered charities, and interchange++ pricing (card network interchange fees plus card network scheme fees plus a negotiated margin) -- all require contacting sales for an exact quote. Independent reviewers note at least five documented categories of additional/hidden cost (implementation, training, and add-on fees) that can raise total cost of ownership beyond the negotiated headline rate. No specific numeric rate range is publicly available, so no figure is given here rather than estimating one.
